title: Resolution urging Albany to pass the New York Fair Housing Act
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.6958, the New York Fair Housing Act. The bill, modeled on New Jersey's affordable housing framework, would require municipalities to adopt fair share affordable housing plans on a 10-year cycle, with a 40-year affordability period for rentals and 30 years for sale units. It would also create a New York Affordable Housing Trust Fund and an online portal of affordable housing listings.
